finding_resolutions.issue: Initial run_case native sessions escaped the outer hard watchdog group.
finding_resolutions.evidence: A scoped benchmark.subprocess facade strips the native start_new_session option, checks inherited PGID, and kills/joins a launched child if admission validation fails. It delegates other module attributes and does not globally monkeypatch subprocess. Local benchmark cleanup kills the direct child; existing run_case finally joins/closes it. The outer candidate_run/run_child group covers native and ps observers.

finding_resolutions.issue: Reusable benchmark validation alone could accept missing legacy warmup guard or a different ordinary warmup count.
finding_resolutions.evidence: Every returned process must now show warmup_guard1 on all raw records and ready.warmup==ready.warm_callbacks==128.

finding_resolutions.issue: A changed filename set did not alone bind the approved candidate bytes.
finding_resolutions.evidence: Preflight now requires exact selected-source keyset equality, exact three changed paths, approved source review/findings[], and each candidate hash equal the corresponding reviewed absolute path.

approved_protocol: Four fixed/variable10k/million cases, five matched pairs per case, alternating baseline/candidate pair order,120 completed ordinary samples and128 guarded warmups: planned40 fresh processes and4800 measured samples.

Each completed run retains native.log and full result.json, checks process exit/result, validates current source/prepared identity and current binary digest, then writes progress. Baseline binary must equal the prior allocation-qualification digest. Candidate build receipt names the exact output path, exits0, binds the candidate source baseline and reports source/prepared stability.
Matched baseline/candidate raw geometry dictionaries must be equal for every sample; shared compare_geometry also checks10k/million clip-workload identities within each build.

Common validator rejects active diagnostic profile/input/source-detail modes in these ordinary calls, checks completed tag/generation/callback/phase sums and minimum400 actually clipped cells, and uses end-only external ps observation.

Summaries derive all11 elapsed-work metrics from raw samples using the existing nearest-rank method, plus process-wide Go allocation observations. Targets remain the existing4ms p95/6ms p99 per-run limits.
preconditions: Invoke compare.py through the reviewed candidate_run.py/run_child route so the process group belongs to the outer watchdog.
Wait for all concurrent adapter/test work to finish before latency processes; parent reports those gates terminal, but this source certificate does not independently execute or classify them.

Hold candidate repository/prepared bytes, phase producer files and both binaries stable throughout the campaign. Actual terminal raw receipts must be audited separately before any comparison result or benefit is qualified.
limitations: Read-only producer/source/hash review only. No fixture, native/window/input, performance, test/build, provider or Git operations were executed by the reviewer.
No runtime outcomes, target pass, speedup, allocation attribution or full P6/Mac acceptance is certified before the campaign.
Outer hard group cleanup covers interruptions; on a hard kill an unfinished run may lack its final per-run receipt and must remain incomplete, not silently count toward40.

Selected-source/prepared and recorded build linkage is not a complete compiler/SDK/module-cache closure. Compare producer_sha256 is an end-state file hash; freeze/entry captures must remain separate provenance.
Local native cleanup kills/joins the direct child; it relies on outer group ownership for hard-stop descendant coverage.
Same-ticket values measure elapsed work, not physical GPU execution/presentation or native/GPU allocations. End-only RSS/CPU snapshots do not yield baseline/warm RSS or process CPU deltas.
